hints.title: Difference Array Coordinate Boundary
hints.text: Use a difference array of size 52 to mark interval additions at start and subtractions at end + 1.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Coverage
hints.text: Compute running prefix sums across coordinates 1 to 50 to find coverage count for each point.

hints.title: Target Interval Verification
hints.text: Verify that every integer between left and right has coverage strictly greater than 0.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing each range independently per query point is linear, but difference array handles coverage in O(1) space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Difference array of fixed size 52 marks and sweeps points in O(n + M) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks all integers in [left, right] have non-zero coverage.
